An attacker wants 1,000 fake identities. Each needs a referral chain. The island registry maps every link.

A referrer locks 100 units for 12 epochs. Each backs at most 3 people per epoch. Star clusters trigger review. Forgery freezes the whole chain. A beacon check flags density above 0.6.

Cost math: 1,000 clones need 34 referrers locking 3,400 units. A 40% hit rate loses 13,600 units. The summit ledger publishes every chain.
